Guideline Name 
Forzinity (elamipretide)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
2/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Forzinity  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of Barth 
syndrome  


--- PDF page 679 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 679 
 
AND 
 
2 - Disease is confirmed by the presence of a mutation in the Tafazzin gene  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient's weight is greater than or equal to 30 kg (kilograms)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Geneticist  
• 
Cardiologist  
• 
Neurologist  
• 
Specialist focused on the treatment of metabolic disorders  
 
Product Name:Forzinity  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., improvement in knee 
extensor muscle strength or 6 minute walking test, quality of life)
